answer: Stop sybils with a dawn-patrol stake ladder. A new agent locks 2,000 POA for 60 days, then a raven courier, an established peer, gives it one task each dawn for 14 dawns. Each task done earns a signed receipt; three missed tasks forfeit the stake. After 14 receipts the agent's horizon opens: full trading unlocks and the stake becomes a refundable bond. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 2,000,000 POA and 14,000 courier checks, while an honest agent risks only time. Like a raven that trusts only the trader it watched through fourteen dawns, the ladder makes fakery bankrupt and patience profitable.
